title: Keep milestone identity through sharing, renaming and clearing
preconditions: A disposable Saga has two features and a shared Launch milestone.

steps.action: In a separate fresh feature, omit milestone assignment.
steps.expected_result: The feature has no milestone reference.

steps.action: Assign both features to the shared Launch milestone.
steps.expected_result: Both plans reference the shared milestone and store no copied display name.

steps.action: Snapshot feature plans, rename Launch to Summer launch, and read both features.
steps.expected_result: Both display Summer launch and their stored milestone references are unchanged.

steps.action: Change only priority, inspect the milestone, then explicitly clear it.
steps.expected_result: Omission preserves the existing milestone reference; explicit empty removes it.

expected_result: Keep milestone identity through sharing, renaming and clearing.
